gap.reason: Since ui-73df5d1b4d4c the Framework declares how a panel is given (sf-tabs 1.5.4: one <div role="tabpanel" data-entry="<item id>"> per item, printed beside the items setting), but Docara cannot take it from a Markdown page yet: a :::ui.* directive carries only a JSON object of scalar settings, its manifest contract admits string, boolean, integer and number props but not the list-typed items setting, and a Framework directive cannot hold Markdown or another directive, so there is no place for the panel content.
gap.fallback: Use the typed :::tabs block with level-three headings; it renders accessible tabs from Framework classes.
gap.admission: Docara decides how a Markdown page writes the panels (an authoring syntax), lets a Framework manifest declare a list-typed prop with its item fields, and prints one tabpanel per item; ui.tabs then lands with its manifest, consumer policy, tests, a docs page with a live example and a catalogue entry, and this record is removed.
